name: Broccoli & cheese bake — optimized (פשטידת ברוקולי, גרסה ממוטבת)

source.author: Optimized version of broccoli_cheese_bake
source.notes: Dual-lens-optimized version of broccoli_cheese_bake, adopted per user request. Changes from the original: NO added salt (the Bulgarian is already salty), whole-spelt flour + whole-wheat panko (more fiber), the yellow-cheese topping halved to ~15 g, and +2 egg whites for protein. Everything else identical. Analyzed for the whole bake; per_serving = batch ÷ 8 (~165 g). Estimate.

serving_desc: ≈165 g slice (batch ÷8) — side or light main; 2 slices = a fuller meal

ingredients.note: sets the salt level; verify pasteurized
added for protein, no extra fat
Bulgarian brings enough; taste the mix

steps: Soften the broccoli in boiling water a few minutes; drain VERY well and cool. Keep a few florets aside, roughly chop the rest.
Sauté the onion in olive oil until soft and golden; add garlic ~30 sec.
Mix cottage, white cheese, Bulgarian, 3 eggs + 2 egg whites, whole-spelt flour, cornflour, baking powder and pepper (no added salt — taste first).
Fold in the broccoli and onion.
Transfer to a dish, level, top with reserved florets, ~15 g yellow cheese, an even layer of whole-wheat panko, and a few sprays of oil.
Bake 180 °C top-bottom 45–55 min until set and golden. Rest 10–15 min before slicing.

batch_totals.note: Whole bake (8 slices), optimized. Vs the original: no added salt (~340 vs ~425 mg sodium/slice), whole-grain flour + panko (more fiber), lighter yellow-cheese topping, +2 egg whites — slightly more protein, a touch less fat, more fiber, less sodium.

him.verdict: The optimized broccoli bake is a top vegetable dish for your cut: ~13.5 g protein per 171 kcal slice (~7.9 g protein per 100 kcal) with ~3 g fiber and a big folate/vitamin-C load from 600 g broccoli, now with lower sodium (~340 mg, no added salt), whole-grain flour + panko, and a lighter cheese topping. High protein, high micronutrients, low calories — exactly the profile you want. Pair with a lean protein to make it a full meal.
flags: ~13.5 g protein / 171 kcal slice (~7.9 g protein per 100 kcal)
lower sodium (~340 mg/slice) — no added salt
broccoli-forward: folate + vitamin C; big veg volume for the calories
suggested_mods: Great as-is; pair with chicken/fish for a full high-protein meal
Add chili flakes or nutmeg for flavor without sodium

her_preconception.verdict: An excellent, now-lower-sodium preconception dish. 600 g broccoli = folate (her #1 nutrient), 3 eggs + 2 whites = choline + protein, cheeses = calcium, broccoli's vitamin C aids iron absorption, and it's fully baked. Just verify the Bulgarian is pasteurized (it's baked through, so low risk). One to make regularly for her.
prenatal_highlights: folate from 600 g broccoli — her top preconception nutrient
choline from eggs; vitamin C (broccoli) aids iron absorption
calcium + protein from the cheeses; high fiber; lower sodium; fully baked

safety_advisories.note: Bulgarian cheese is a brined soft cheese — verify pasteurized. It's baked through here (considered safe cooked).
safety_advisories.swap: verify pasteurized, or use a little extra white cheese

suggested_mods: No changes needed — folate-rich and now lower in sodium

adopted_note: Adopted 2026-10-08 as the optimized version of the broccoli-cheese pashtida (supersedes broccoli_cheese_bake for actual use). Per slice (of 8, ~165 g): ~171 kcal, 13.5 g protein, 3 g fiber, ~340 mg sodium. him 9 / her 9. Standing spec: NO added salt, whole-spelt flour + whole-wheat panko, ~15 g yellow-cheese topping, +2 egg whites. Drain the broccoli very well; rest 10-15 min before slicing. Verify Bulgarian is pasteurized.
cooking_guide: Cook the frozen broccoli in boiling water just a few minutes — don't let it go to mush. Then DRAIN AND PRESS OUT the water very well (wet broccoli = soggy pashtida). Reserve a few florets for the top, roughly chop the rest.
Sauté the onion in the olive oil until soft and lightly golden; add the garlic for ~30 sec (don't brown it).

Whisk the 3 eggs + 2 egg whites, then stir in the cottage, white cheese and crumbled Bulgarian with the whole-spelt flour, cornflour, baking powder and pepper. NO added salt — taste first, the Bulgarian is salty.
Fold in the well-drained broccoli and the onion until evenly coated.
Transfer to a greased/lined dish, level the top. Arrange the reserved florets, scatter ~15 g yellow cheese, then an even layer of whole-wheat panko and a few sprays of oil for the crisp crust.
Bake at 180 °C (conventional, top-bottom) 45–55 min until the center is set and the top is deep golden; a knife in the middle comes out clean.
REST 10–15 min before cutting so the slices hold together.
Tips: chili flakes or a grating of nutmeg lift the flavor without adding salt; pair a slice with chicken or fish for a complete cut meal.
